# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.1 — Library overview

- Describe library counts, tags and notes available through ReadShore MCP 1.6.0.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `readshore` MCP server pointing at ReadShore's hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint (`https://readshore.app/mcp`).
- Auth uses OAuth 2.1 with ReadShore sign-in (authorization code + PKCE, dynamic client registration) — no API key or client ID to configure.
- Logo: ReadShore's app icon.
